muc_tieu: Sua dinh nghia overshoot/thoi gian xac lap bang cach them pha dung (dwell) tai diem moc, do chi trong cua so dwell; quet T tim chu ky ngan nhat dat sai so cuoi dwell <= 1 mm va overshoot <= 5 %.

trajectory.boundary_conditions: dung han tai moi diem: v=0, a=0
trajectory.dwell_source: tai-lieu/tong-quan.md muc 7.1: tre dong/nha dau kep 0,2-0,3 s, chon danh dinh 0,25 s

joint_model.cross_coupling: bo qua tuong tac cheo giua 3 khop (giai thiet tach khop)

giathieu: Khop quay duoc mo hinh hoa nhu 3 he quan tinh-nhot doc lap, bo qua trong luc va tuong tac dong hoc cheo.
Quy dao thao tac: 3 doan bac 5 noi tiep, giua cac doan co pha dung dwell_s tai diem moc (kep/nha vat).
Sai so bam quy doi ve khong gian thao tac bang FK voi goc khop thuc te.
Chu ky toan he thong = 3T + 2*dwell + xu ly anh + cho khung hinh + Serial (dry-run).
notes: Run nay thay the metric cua run 2026-11-18: overshoot/thoi gian xac lap chi do trong cua so dwell, khong doan sang doan ke tiep.
